treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the United States of America and the Government of the Italian Republic for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and the prevention of fraud or fiscal evasion (1999, with Protocol)
eif_quote: Stati Uniti d'America ... Firma: Washington 25.08.1999; Ratifica: L. 03.03.2009, n.20 In vigore dal : 16.12.2009
source_title: US-Italy Convention and Protocol 1999 (English authentic text, IRS copy hosted by MEF); cross-checked with Legge 3 marzo 2009 n. 20, G.U. n. 64 del 18-3-2009

rates.quote: (a) 5 percent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which has owned at least 25 percent of the voting stock of the company paying the dividends for a 12 month period ending on the date the dividend is declared; and
(b) 15 percent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient of the royalties is the beneficial owner thereof, the tax so charged shall not exceed: ... (b) 8 percent of the gross amount in all other cases.

ppt.quote: The provisions of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the shares or other rights in respect of which the dividend is paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment.

notes: Not an MLI-covered pair (Italy not a Party; US not a signatory); anti-abuse is via treaty main-purpose clauses (Art. 10(10), 11(9), 12(8), 22(3)) and a full Limitation on Benefits article (Protocol Art. 2). Art. 28(2)(a): WHT provisions effective for amounts paid or credited on or after the first day of the second month following EIF (2009-12-16 -> 2010-02-01). Royalties: 5% for computer software and industrial/commercial/scientific equipment (Art. 12(2)(a)); copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work (excluding software, films, broadcasting tapes) taxable only in residence State (Art. 12(3)). Dividends: 0% for qualified governmental entity holding <25% (Art. 10(8)); RIC/REIT dividends excluded from 5% tier and REIT 15% only in limited cases (Art. 10(9)). Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)) for qualified governmental entities, government-guaranteed/insured debt, credit sales of goods/merchandise/services and of equipment. Branch profits tax allowed at 5% (Art. 10(6)-(7)). Art. 28(3): 12-month election to keep the 1984 prior Convention (expired).
